content: Linear webhook payloads include an 'actor' object (id/type/name/email/url) identifying who triggered the action; type is user, oauth client, or integration; may be null if deleted. Payload also carries action (create/update/remove), type (Issue/Comment/...), updatedFrom (previous values of changed props), webhookId, webhookTimestamp. Header Linear-Delivery is a v4 UUID uniquely identifying the payload -> use for dedupe. Linear docs give NO guidance on self-loop prevention; the app must filter actor.id against its own identity (viewer.id for an API-key bot, app id for OAuth actor=app). Linear does not suppress webhooks caused by the same token that created the webhook.
